# Forward Fitness

> > Personal training gym in St. Louis specializing in functional fitness, obstacle course racing (OCR), and nutrition coaching for adults 35+, led by Mike and Suzanne Klaus.

Forward Fitness offers FIT Camp classes, Spartan Race training, kettlebell certification programs, and InBody Scan assessments. The gym emphasizes injury prevention, mobility work, and positive psychology principles inspired by books like The Happiness Advantage and Atomic Habits.

## Key Topics

- Personal Training
- Obstacle Course Racing (OCR)
- Spartan Races & Spartan Trifecta
- Kettlebell Training (RKC Certified)
- InBody Scan Body Composition
- FIT Camp Classes
- Nutrition Coaching
- Mike & Suzanne Klaus
- Mobility & Recovery
- Injury Prevention
- Goal Setting & Habit Formation
- Functional Movement Systems
- Adults 35+ Fitness
- St. Louis Maplewood Location
- Yoga Tune-Up & Foam Rolling

## Core Services & Programs

- [Forward Fitness – Personal Training • Gym • Nutrition Counseling](https://forwardfitnessstl.com): Homepage: Personal training & nutrition for adults 35+ in St. Louis
- [Services](https://forwardfitnessstl.com/services): Main services: FIT Camp, OCR training, personal training & InBody Scan
- [OCR – Obstacle Course Racing](https://forwardfitnessstl.com/classes/ocr): Obstacle Course Racing program: Spartan training at Tillis Park & Art Hill
- [Schedule](https://forwardfitnessstl.com/schedule): Class schedule and coaching appointment booking system
- [Slow Your Roll – Recovery Workshop](https://forwardfitnessstl.com/slow-your-roll): Recovery workshop: foam rolling, mobility & Yoga Tune-Up balls in Maplewood

## Training Resources & Guides

- [Kettlebell Training Guide](https://forwardfitnessstl.com/kettlebell-3): Big 6 kettlebell movements guide: swing, clean, snatch & Turkish get-up
- [Mobility Workouts](https://forwardfitnessstl.com/mobility): Mobility workout routines: RAMP, morning routine & banded exercises
- [7 Common Kettlebell Swing Mistakes](https://forwardfitnessstl.com/2019/08/7-common-kettlebell-swing-mistakes): Kettlebell swing form corrections: hinge technique & hip drive tips
- [Kettlebell Snatch: The Best Total Body Exercise](https://forwardfitnessstl.com/2015/07/kettlebell-snatch-the-best-total-body-exercise): Kettlebell snatch benefits: explosive power & 22 kcal/min burn rate
